skill.name: browser-act-skill-forge
skill.description: Explores websites with browser-act, verifies API or DOM workflows, and packages the results as reusable skill files and scripts.
skill.summary: Builds reusable browser-act skills from verified website exploration workflows.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: No prompt injection or clear credential exfiltration was found in the reviewed files. The skill is dual-use: it intentionally explores website internals, automates authenticated browser workflows, and generates local scripts. Most static hits are markdown examples, but shell command substitution and generated Python execution are real medium-risk surfaces.

remediation.issue: Generated skills rely on shell command substitution for Python-produced JavaScript.
remediation.suggestion: Use a safer browser-act execution path, quote parameters strictly, and reject inputs that can alter shell syntax.

remediation.issue: The workflow encourages internal endpoint discovery and large-scale extraction from authenticated pages.
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit authorization checks, rate guidance, and policy reminders before extraction or batch execution.

remediation.issue: Operation workflows can capture and reproduce state-changing requests.
remediation.suggestion: Require dry-run testing, user confirmation before live submission, and logs for POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE workflows.

remediation.issue: Generated Python scripts are executed locally during verification.
remediation.suggestion: Constrain scripts to the documented template, disallow imports beyond the template, and review before execution.

semantic_findings.title: Authenticated Internal Endpoint Automation
semantic_findings.description: The skill guides agents to explore frontend internal endpoints and automate extraction through a logged-in browser session. This is useful for authorized work, but it can enable large-scale scraping of third-party sites.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The stated purpose includes endpoint discovery, reusable extraction, and direct use of frontend internal endpoints in the user session.

semantic_findings.title: Generated Local Script Execution Surface
semantic_findings.description: The workflow creates Python wrappers that output browser JavaScript and then verifies them by running local commands. Unsafe generated code or unsanitized parameters could execute unexpected local or browser-side behavior.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The files explicitly describe generating scripts and executing them during verification, even though the intended scripts only print JavaScript.

semantic_findings.title: State-Changing Browser Operation Automation
semantic_findings.description: The operation workflow captures form submission requests and can package direct API or DOM submission methods. This can automate authenticated state changes, so misuse could affect accounts or data.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The operation guide covers POST-like request capture, API submission strategy, and DOM submission fallback within authenticated workflows.

content.value_statement: Teams often repeat fragile browser exploration when they need web data or account workflows. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code explore once, verify methods, and package reusable browser-act skills.
actual_capabilities: Turns website objectives into browser-act skill packages with SKILL.md files and scripts.
Guides API endpoint discovery, network capture, DOM fallback, and AI workflow documentation.
Defines verification steps for generated Python wrappers that output browser-side JavaScript.
Provides templates for capabilities, enum parameters, pagination, limitations, and experience notes.
Supports data extraction and operation workflows inside a user-authenticated browser session.
limitations: Generated skills depend on the target website structure and can break after redesigns.
Authenticated workflows require the user to provide valid browser access.
The skill does not guarantee compliance with each website policy or terms.
Generated scripts require review before use in sensitive workspaces.

use_cases.title: Package Repeat Web Extraction
use_cases.description: Create a reusable browser-act skill for recurring list, search, or detail-page extraction tasks.

use_cases.title: Automate Account Workflows
use_cases.description: Document and verify browser workflows that perform authorized actions in logged-in web tools.

use_cases.title: Prototype Site-Specific Tools
use_cases.description: Discover viable API, network capture, or DOM methods before building a durable automation package.

prompt_templates.title: Build A Basic Extraction Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one website and one data type.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a browser-act skill for extracting visible records from this website: [URL]. Include fields, pagination, and known limitations.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Logged-In Workflow Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for an authorized account workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Forge a reusable skill for this logged-in workflow: [workflow]. Use my browser session and require confirmation before live submission.

prompt_templates.title: Compare API And DOM Strategies
prompt_templates.prompt: Explore [URL] and identify the best reusable method. Compare direct API, network capture, DOM extraction, and AI workflow fallback.

prompt_templates.title: Package Batch Execution
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for repeated extraction at scale.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a verified skill for [site] and then design a batch plan for [volume]. Include retry, rate, and resume guidance.

output_examples.input: Create a skill that extracts product listings from a target site.
output_examples.output: A generated skill folder with a SKILL.md guide, script wrappers, verified pagination notes, and documented limitations.

output_examples.input: Automate an authorized form workflow in my logged-in browser.
output_examples.output: A reusable operation skill with prerequisites, safe verification steps, required parameters, and confirmation guidance.

output_examples.input: Find the endpoint behind a website search page.
output_examples.output: A capability plan that records the viable API or network capture method and explains when DOM fallback is needed.

best_practices: Review generated scripts before running them in sensitive directories.
Use only websites and accounts where you have permission to automate access.
Test each generated capability with small inputs before batch execution.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill to bypass authentication, paywalls, or access controls.
Do not run generated scripts from untrusted edits without inspection.
Do not launch large batches before confirming rate limits and output quality.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates reusable browser-act skill packages with instructions, script wrappers, verification notes, and limitations.

faq.question: Does it send data to a third-party service?
faq.answer: The skill text says exploration artifacts stay local and requests go to the target site.

faq.question: Can it work with logged-in websites?
faq.answer: Yes, when the user is already authorized and the browser session has the required access.

faq.question: Can it bypass access controls?
faq.answer: No. The documented boundary is what the user can manually access in the browser.

faq.question: Why should scripts be reviewed?
faq.answer: The workflow creates local Python files and browser-side JavaScript, so review reduces execution risk.

faq.question: When should I use it instead of one-off browser automation?
faq.answer: Use it when a task will repeat, needs batch execution, or requires a verified strategy before scaling.
